skyzh.option.displayPriority.tooltip:
Other utility mods can also change displayed text, which may prevent translations from appearing correctly.
Adjust this option to give translated text higher display priority.
This can disable some features of other mods. Change it only when necessary!
- Default: Keep compatibility with other utility mods.
- High: Increase the display priority of translated text.
- Force: Give translated text the highest priority and block changes that could interfere with it.
skyzh.option.translateItemNames.tooltip: When off, item names and their references in dialogue, system messages, holograms and menus stay in English. Other text remains translated.
skyzh.option.enabled.tooltip: Whether the mod translates anything at all.
skyzh.option.updateCheck.tooltip: Automatically check for updates and download and install new versions when available.
skyzh.option.translateSkyBlockName.toolt: Translate the game mode name SkyBlock as 空岛生存.
skyzh.option.originalTips.tooltip: When a server message mentions a translated item, explain which key toggles original text. Press again to restore translations. Disable to hide these hints.
skyzh.option.captureUntranslated.tooltip: Records untranslated text and mistranslations to a file in the game directory as they are found. Leave this off unless you are a developer.
skyzh.option.captureNotifications.toolti: Report newly captured untranslated text, colour, mixed-language, alignment, continuation and numeric issues in chat.
skyzh.option.autoClearCapture.tooltip: Automatically clear text captured during the previous session each time the game starts.
skyzh.welcome.title: Thank you for trying SkyBlockZH!
skyzh.welcome.description:
The mod is still being improved. To report a translation or corpus issue, click the button on the left to open GitHub.
Choose the translation settings you prefer.
skyzh.category.translation.tooltip: Choose whether the SkyBlock name, item names and mob names are translated.
skyzh.category.advanced.tooltip: Text spacing, display priority and capture tools.
skyzh.option.updateInstall.tooltip:
What happens when a new mod version is found. Translation updates are not affected.
- Auto install: download, then install on the next game restart
- Ask to install: download, then announce it in chat and install when clicked
- Check only: announce in chat, then download and install when clicked
skyzh.option.translateMobNames.tooltip: When off, mob names on nameplates, holograms and in items, the scoreboard, boss bars and other text stay in English. Other text remains translated.
skyzh.option.legacyFont.tooltip:
How Chinese text is rendered. Changing it reloads resources.
- 1.12.2 compact: Minecraft 1.12.2 glyph widths, with narrow commas and full stops
- Full-width: the current vanilla full-width glyphs
